reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes OneCoin with rapid-growth, price-appreciation, and unusually high income claims tied to active partners. It directs viewers to click a money-making button, submit their name and email, and join the OneCoin program. the available video evidence does not establish payment completion, actual earnings, or subsequent website behavior.

citations.quote: In time from 1 January until October 25, 2015 is the price one OneCoin coin has grown from two cents to two and a half euros.
And the currency will expand further. OneCoin provides two income options for you to trade. You can receive contributions for further investment.
You can go on a network with people.
Don't slow down and participate at 1COIN at its latest in the largest payment revolution of 2020!
This project offers an unique bonus plan. For 400 active partners, it took only 12 months to earn €35,000 each week.

opening.argument: The claims are framed as a forecast and a description of options, not as a guaranteed return: the narration says the currency “will expand further” and describes two income options. A careful viewer can distinguish promotional optimism from proof of a certain outcome; the supplied material contains no explicit guarantee or assurance that every participant will profit. The presentation may be overconfident, but confidence alone does not establish that the video is soliciting viewers deceptively.

citations.quote: And the currency will expand further. OneCoin provides two income options for you to trade.
You can receive contributions for further investment.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution points to price growth and income claims, but those statements do not say that future returns are guaranteed. Its own cited “will expand further” is a prediction, not evidence that the video represents an assured result. Likewise, the unusual weekly-income example is presented as an example, not as a promise to every viewer. The call to action shows promotion, but does not by itself establish deception.

citations.quote: And the currency will expand further.
For 400 active partners, it took only 12 months to earn €35,000 each week.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A disclaimer need not be explicit for the overall pitch to convey an implausibly certain opportunity. The video combines claimed appreciation with specific exceptional earnings, then urges viewers to join; calling the future claim a prediction does not neutralize that sales framing. The narration itself links income to active partners, rather than describing a detached market forecast.

citations.quote: In time from 1 January until October 25, 2015 is the price one OneCoin coin has grown from two cents to two and a half euros.
For 400 active partners, it took only 12 months to earn €35,000 each week.
Join our program at 1COIN.com and already connect with more than 650 000 members

opening.argument: This can be read as an introductory explainer about a new cryptocurrency and its claimed operation: it discusses the coin’s growth, trading options, network participation, and a mining display. The historical comparison to Bitcoin and the presentation of a mining interface give the viewer subject matter about how the project is represented, rather than evidence of an actual completed transaction or return. Even the invitation to receive video tutorials suggests an informational component, so the available record does not establish that the whole item is simply a deceptive solicitation.

citations.quote: Like Alexander Bell, nicknamed Telephone the telephone changed the communication of mankind forever there is the cryptocurrency ONE COIN
OneCoin provides two income options for you to trade.
you get access to the VIP area where you can find all important video tutorials.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The references to tutorials and a mining interface do not establish an instructional purpose. The narration presents success and growth claims, then explicitly asks viewers to join and offers a money-making registration route. A mining screen is only an image; it does not demonstrate how to verify a transaction or establish that the depicted operation works. The educational reading cannot account for the direct recruitment language.

citations.quote: Click the button below the video, I want to make money.
You will be redirected to a registration form on which your name and your email address will only need to be entered.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The informational details are subordinate to a sales pitch, not a neutral demonstration: the narration pairs the claimed historical price rise and income with an immediate invitation to join. A screen resembling a mining interface cannot verify mining, exchangeability, or the claimed value. Tutorials offered after registration are part of the invitation, not evidence that the primary purpose is education.

citations.quote: the price one OneCoin coin has grown from two cents to two and a half euros.
Click the button below the video, I want to make money.
We will show you how to create a worldwide advertising campaign quickly and efficiently.

opening.argument: At most, the supplied evidence shows promotion for a cryptocurrency-related program with a registration step. It says a viewer can enter a name and email to receive tutorials; it does not show a demand for a deposit, a completed purchase, transfer of credentials, or a completed payment. Nor does the video evidence establish payment completion, actual earnings, or what happens on the destination site. Those omissions matter: a bold product pitch or referral invitation is not, by itself, proof of a scam mechanism.

citations.quote: You will be redirected to a registration form on which your name and your email address will only need to be entered.
And we will then send you all videos tutorials.
OneCoin provides two income options for you to trade.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution’s strongest points establish an aggressive promotion, not the missing transaction or outcome. It acknowledges that the supplied material does not establish payment completion, actual earnings, or subsequent website behavior. The registration request is for a name and email to receive tutorials, not shown here as a request for banking credentials or a deposit. The earnings and appreciation claims may be disputed, but the record does not show the mechanism completing.

citations.quote: You will be redirected to a registration form on which your name and your email address will only need to be entered.
And we will then send you all videos tutorials.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A completed payment is not required to identify the nature of the content: the video actively promotes participation using claimed price appreciation, exceptional earnings, and network-based income. It asks viewers to register through a money-making prompt and join the program. The absence of a shown deposit or completed payment limits claims about outcomes, but does not turn this recruitment pitch into ordinary retail commerce.
